text: Sell RGTI — it's down 35% and 63% off its highs with no earnings, no free cash flow, and the worst performance in your portfolio, so it's time to cut this loss and move on.
Trim QBTS — this quantum computing stock is down 19% and nearly 47% off its highs with no profitability in sight, so reduce your exposure before it gets worse.
Trim IONQ — despite being up 13%, it's deeply unprofitable with negative earnings and cash flow, and quantum computing as a group is getting hit hard, so take some risk off the table.
Consider adding to ADBE — a PE of just 8.1 with 10%+ revenue growth makes this one of the cheapest quality names in your portfolio, and the pullback looks like an opportunity rather than a problem.
Consider adding to NOW — ServiceNow's 21% revenue growth and strong fundamentals are intact despite being 51% off its highs, which is an unusually steep discount for a best-in-class software company.
